profile.headline: Software Developer at Siemens PLM Software
profile.summary:
a summary is too much work, so here's my github & interests! https://github.com/cnguy

| interested in servers, distributed programming, low-latency programming, system design and development, type level programming

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
working with an amazing team on Siemens NX :)

primary technologies: C++. Desktop Applications

* (limited info) utilized core company libraries to add features to production C++ code that enhance user experience
* developed C++ and JavaScript prototypes that integrate 3rd-party services with Siemens NX
* introduced unit testing into new library to increase code coverage to meet requirements for production (80%)
* presented prototype demos to several teams to spark discussions regarding requirements

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
primary technologies: JavaScript (ES6), Vue.js, GraphQL, Node.js

* assisted in developing the applicant / company profile pages, the jobs listing page, and the post a job page for https://kunvet.com (https://youtu.be/GSo5veOq65I)
* worked primarily on optimizing graphql queries and vue.js rendering performance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
primary technologies: JavaScript (ES6), React.js, Redux, Node.js, AWS

* developed React.js / AWS S3 architecture (along with another software engineer) for https://richuncles.com/blog (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-ZC78tiRBQQ)
* increased performance of React.js web app by removing unnecessary re-renders and network requests from existing code
* actively sought and fixed UI/UX frontend bugs
